name: rem-sdlc
description: Deterministic, gated SDLC loop for full-stack JavaScript projects. Turns a ticket into a merged PR through intake → implement → validate → review → PR → revalidate, with a single track file as source of truth.

metadata.description: A portable Claude Code plugin that codifies a track-driven SDLC cycle

plugins.name: rem-sdlc
plugins.description: Nine slash commands (/rem-sdlc:init, /rem-sdlc:intake, /rem-sdlc:implement, /rem-sdlc:validate, /rem-sdlc:review, /rem-sdlc:pr, /rem-sdlc:pr-comments, /rem-sdlc:revalidate, /rem-sdlc:cycle) that turn a ticket into a merged PR with gated phases and a machine-readable track file.
